mark start
warp IceCavern IceCavern_FromZoraFountain adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark llegada
wait 3000               # B loads after A (r03_pareja) or with it (run.ps1): wait for it
mark r01-hielo-rojo        # the first red ice
place 17.30 103.30 79.80
wait 300
flag IceCavern_Room00_RedIce_Melted 1
wait 600               # the other one sees us in this room
mark r02-caverna           # the first cavern
place 0.00 100.80 35.90

wait 600

wait 300

wait 600
mark r10-salida-trasera    # the way out under the fountain

flag IceCavern_Room02_DungeonIn 1          # where one player is: never in B
flag IceCavern_Room02_DungeonExit 1          # where one player is: never in B
flag IceCavern_Room02_PassedThrough 1          # where one player is: never in B
